name: LiteLLM
description: LiteLLM is an OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple LLM providers with virtual API keys, usage tracking, and spending budgets.

notes.text: Sign in as admin using LITELLM_MASTER_KEY from /opt/litellm/.env. HTTPS uses a self-signed certificate that you must accept in your browser.
HTTP on port 80 is enabled by default for local access and sends credentials unencrypted. Set var_litellm_http=no at install time to redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
